status: retention and mounting geometry added; flexible wiring and physical qualification unfinished

J320.handling_note: Use a thumb or index finger as shown for the bottom-contact type. Do not use a fingernail or a thin tool. Release the actuator before withdrawing the FFC parallel to the PCB.
J320.scope: The upper and external boxes allocate access space. They do not model the internal latch mechanism, establish a tolerance fit, or specify the complete flexible cable. The finger cylinder is a planning allowance, not an ergonomic qualification.
J320.reference_drawing_note: The retained family drawing gives the reference open-actuator envelope. The current product page confirms the 30-position bottom-contact 2 mm body; this is not a measurement of the assembled keyboard.
